title: Resolution Allocation with Learnable Resizing and Spectral Filter Parameterization
abstract: arXiv:2610.20274v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Learnable downsampling and spectral-domain filter parameterizations have each made convolutional networks more flexible, but their interaction has not been systematically examined. We bridge this gap by examining convolutional kernels learned in the spatial and spectral domains, together with learned downsampling ratios under a cropped resizing implementation. We find that spectral and spatial kernels respond differently to learned resolution allocation, with larger gains for the spectral kernel. We observe this consistently on three datasets (EuroSAT, CIFAR-10 and STL-10) and at two model sizes (differences in accuracy gain of +0.013 to +0.028 on held-out test sets). Part of this difference reflects the greater gain of the spectral kernel from retaining more spatial area, but the difference remains positive when total retained area is matched. translated_title: 基于可学习缩放与谱域滤波器参数化的分辨率分配
translated_abstract: 可学习的下采样与谱域滤波器参数化各自都使卷积网络更加灵活，但两者之间的相互作用尚未被系统性研究。我们通过考察在空间域和谱域中学习到的卷积核，以及在裁剪缩放实现下的可学习下采样比例，来弥补这一研究空白。我们发现谱域核与空间域核对可学习分辨率分配的响应不同，谱域核获得了更大的增益。我们在三个数据集（EuroSAT、CIFAR-10 和 STL-10）以及两种模型规模上一致地观察到这一现象（在保留测试集上准确率增益差异为 +0.013 至 +0.028）。这种差异部分反映了谱域核从保留更多空间区域中所获得的更大增益，但当总保留面积相同时，该差异仍然为正。这一模式在所有数据集和模型规模上均可观察到，尽管其幅度及依赖关系……
tldr: 该论文首次系统研究了可学习下采样与谱域滤波器参数化之间的相互作用，发现谱域卷积核比空间域卷积核从可学习分辨率分配中获得更大的准确率增益，且这一优势在匹配总保留面积后依然存在。
